unknowns_and_not_graded: No unit is graded: both are paused, with 0 spend and 0 results in both windows.
Learning budget is unknown without a target cost per result.
Saturation and marginal cost need spend in both windows.
next_steps: Decide the one event that matters (for example a sign-up) and give a target cost per result for it.
Learning budget = target cost per result x 50 / 7 a day. Fund one ad set at that level, or optimise for an earlier event until volume builds.

The ad set in the Engagement test campaign sits at the USD floor of 1.00 a day for impression billing. At that budget, leaving learning on post_engagement would need a cost per result of 0.14 or less (7 days x 1.00 / 50 events).
The ad set in the Awareness test campaign optimises for REACH, which has no result event, so the 50-events learning math doesn't apply; judge it on CPM and frequency once it delivers.
Run this skill again after 30 days of delivery; a unit needs at least 10 results, or 3 times its target in spend, to be graded.
Go deeper (if installed): facebook-ads-campaign-structure to set up the campaign, facebook-ads-launch-checklist before switching it on.
